text.tspan: Protect and share: MFA Delete, access logs, pre-signed URLs, WORM locks
NOT needed to: enable versioning, list deleted versions
Versioning must be enabled · only the bucket owner
(root account) can enable/disable it · CLI/API only,
not the console · can't be used with lifecycle rules
Any request, any account, allowed or denied · analyse with
Athena etc. · logging bucket in the SAME Region (and account)
Never log a bucket into itself: logging loop, grows forever
Console: 1 min to 720 min (12 h) · CLI --expires-in seconds
(default 3600, max 604800 = 7 days) · never longer than the
signer's credentials · holder gets the SIGNER's rights for GET/PUT
e.g. premium video download, ever-changing list of users
vault lock policy → lock it: can no longer be changed
blocks deleting an object VERSION for a set time
Compliance mode: nobody, not even root, can overwrite
or delete; mode can't change, period can't be shortened
Governance mode: most users can't; users with
Retention period: fixed time, can be extended
Legal hold: indefinite, independent of retention;
• Normally the bucket owner pays storage + requests
• Requester Pays: the REQUESTER pays the request
